root_cause.text: In the ath12k driver, when MLO connection preparation fails after initializing an arvif (assigned a link ID) but before it is created (`is_created` remains false), the error path fails to clear the stale link mapping from `ahvif->links_map` because the link deletion logic only executes for arvifs with `is_created == true`, leaving a stale entry that triggers a WARN_ON when a subsequent arvif is initialized with the same link ID.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "When an arvif is initialized in non-AP STA mode but MLO connection preparation fails before the arvif is created (arvif->is_created remains false), the error path attempts to delete all links. However, link deletion only executes when arvif->is_created is true. As a result, ahvif retains a stale entry of arvif that is initialized but not created." The patch adds `ath12k_mac_unassign_link_vif(arvif);` inside the `if (!arvif->is_created)` block in `ath12k_mac_op_change_vif_links()` to clear the mapping for such uncreated arvifs.

candidates.rationale: This condition causes the loop to skip cleanup for arvifs that were initialized (with a link ID) but not created, so the stale link mapping remains in ahvif->links_map.
When is_created is false, the 'continue' skips the code that would clear the links_map entry, leaving a stale mapping that triggers WARN_ON later.
This WARN_ON check does not handle the case where arvif exists but is not fully created; it only warns on NULL, not on stale state.
The early return on NULL arvif aborts cleanup, but if arvif is non-NULL and not created, the error path is not taken, leading to missing cleanup.
This check also only WARNs and returns, but does not handle the case where arvif exists and ar is valid but is_created is false, so cleanup is skipped.
